text.text:
*Original problem*
LOGICAL_CONFIGURATION_ERROR: Service/rcp-validate-payments-api port 'http' targetPort 9090 does not match any container port of Deployment/rcp-validate-payments-api (container ports: [8080], names: ['http']) — traffic would be dropped

*Root cause*
In demo/charts/payments-api/values.yaml, the PR changed `service.targetPort` from 8080 to 9090, but the Deployment only exposes container port 8080 (`app.port`, named `http`). The Service therefore routes to a port nothing listens on and would drop traffic.
